只有.english: only have ...; there is only ...; (used in combination with 才[cai2]) it is only if one ... (that one can ...) (Example: 只有通過治療才能痊愈|只有通过治疗才能痊愈[zhi3 you3 tong1 guo4 zhi4 liao2 cai2 neng2 quan2 yu4] "the only way to cure it is with therapy"); it is only ... (who ...) (Example: 只有男性才有此需要[zhi3 you3 nan2 xing4 cai2 you3 ci3 xu1 yao4] "only men would have such a requirement"); (used to indicate that one has no alternative) one can only (do a certain thing) (Example: 只有屈服[zhi3 you3 qu1 fu2] "the only thing you can do is give in")

空空.english: empty; vacuous; nothing; vacant; in vain; all for nothing; air-to-air (missile)

叫做.english: to be called; to be known as

走過.english: to walk past; to pass by

上面.english: on top of; above-mentioned; also pr. [shang4 mian5]

才不.english: by no means; definitely not; as if!; yeah right!

一次.english: first; first time; once; (math.) linear (of degree one)

到得.english: to arrive at (some place or time)

一塊.english: a piece; a chunk; (fig.) (coll.) (typically preceded by a specifier such as 這|这[zhe4]) aspect; area; dimension (Example: 情感這一塊|情感这一块[qing2gan3 zhe4 yi1kuai4] "the emotional aspect (of it)"); (coll.) one yuan; a dollar; together; in the same place; in company

地方.english: region; regional (away from the central administration); local; area; place; space; room; territory; CL:處|处[chu4],個|个[ge4],塊|块[kuai4]

一些.english: some; a few; a little; (following an adjective) slightly ...er

少見.english: rare; seldom seen; (formal) it's a rare pleasure to see you

所以.english: therefore; as a result; so; the reason why

人心.english: popular feeling; the will of the people

一個.english: a; an; one; the whole (afternoon, summer vacation etc)

切碎.english: to chop up; cut into pieces

在地.english: (Tw) local; native (from Taiwanese 在地, Tai-lo pr. [tsāi-tē])

下來.english: to come down; (completed action marker); (after verb of motion, indicates motion down and towards us, also fig.); (indicates continuation from the past towards us); to be harvested (of crops); to be over (of a period of time); to go among the masses (said of leaders)

一下.english: (after a verb) a bit; a little (indicating brief duration, or softening the tone, or suggesting giving sth a try); all at once; suddenly
